metadata.description: Forgeloom: spec-driven workflow and reusable per-stack knowledge (iOS/Swift, web, backend) for AI-assisted development.

plugins.name: fl
plugins.description: Workflow commands: /fl:define (charter, spec or shared spec across repos), /fl:fix (bug with root cause and regression test), /fl:promote (promote lessons to knowledge/<stack>/patterns/), /fl:import (split an existing all-in-one spec into a multi-repo project without losing text; detects the technologies and creates one git-flow repo per technology), plus a checker for import-ready source specs. Install it once; it is independent of the stack.

plugins.name: ios-swift
plugins.description: Skills and subagents for iOS/macOS in Swift: Swift standards, Swift 6 concurrency, SwiftUI, polished Apple UI with 10 styles, Swift Testing, SwiftData, networking, privacy manifest; OWASP Mobile, accessibility, memory and performance audits.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Skills and subagents for web: professional design with 4 themes, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, WCAG 2.2 accessibility; OWASP Top 10, Core Web Vitals, accessibility and design-system compliance audits.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Skills and subagents for backend (language-agnostic): contract-first API, database, auth, observability; OWASP API Security and OpenAPI contract compliance audits.
